title: RBI External Commercial Borrowings (ECB) Cap Raised to $1 Billion
summary: Eligible borrowers can now raise up to $1 billion via ECB route (up from $750 million) per financial year.

blocks.content: RBI increased the automatic route ECB raising limit for eligible corporate borrowers from **$750 million to $1 billion** per financial year.

items: **FY25 Record**: Indian companies raised a record **$61 billion via ECB** in FY25 (up from $48 billion in FY24).
